quests.title: A Cliff-Side Hero's Past

dialogue.t: Ah, why do people covet my great Glaze Lily garden all day long? If any thieves dare approach, I shall surely have them taste the might of the Guhua Clan's martial arts!
What lowly folk are you? Do you not see that these flowers are kept by someone? How dare you pick them so casually!
Cease this at once!
Wait, so these flowers are...
Indeed, they were found by my keen and discerning eye, and watched over thusly for three days!
...Not planted by you.
*cough* No indeed, but they are mine now.
Verily did I even swear in my heart that I shall care for these flowers and create a lovely and great Glaze Lily garden, far from the strictures and standards of the norm!
Uh, you're going to make a Glaze Lily garden... with these flowers?
But...
What of it? Do you think that I am but a rough person bereft of any sense of aesthetics?
Pah! To think that you would judge books by their covers so.
It's not that. It's just that you say you want to create a Glaze Lily garden... though these flowers are actually Qingxin.
...Hehehehehe, hahahaha!
I get it now, I get it! You're trying to shake my will, aren't you?
But alas for you! I am Tang Wuchou, true disciple of the 320th Guhua Clan generation! Did you really think that you could fool me with such shallow trickery?

dialogue.sit: Does the Guhua Clan really have that many generations of pupils...
You say that, when you're dressed like a Treasure Hoarder...

dialogue.t: How dare you insult the long and venerable history of the Guhua Clan! Have at ye, scoundrels!
Ow, ow, ow ow ow... I'm sorry, I'm sorryyyy! Stop hitting me, please!
This person's martial skills...

dialogue.sit: ...Are a complete wash.

dialogue.t: To think that I, with my many long years of training, would not be your match all the same...
Ah, yes. They say "a fine saddle for a fine horse, a fair sail for a fair boat"... No, wait, that's not it...
"A fine sword for a fair hero," that's how it went! So yes, please take this Glaze Lily with you, O mighty hero...
Didn't we already say that these are Qingxin?
Ah, yes, yes, Qingxin, Qingxin indeed. It is as you say...
Are you really from the Guhua Clan? ...Hmm, right, do you know some guy called Xingqiu?
Xingqiu...
I have never heard this name. What, does this Xingqiu person call himself a Guhua disciple?
Ah, how could such a knave be allowed to sully the Guhua name...
(Right, so he isn't from the Guhua Clan. Actually, y'know, isn't he the one sullying the Guhua name around here?)
One moment, please. Do you have any proof of your claim that you're from the Guhua Clan?
Of course I do, yes! Come now, look at this jade pendant I have on me...
So this is a hereditary treasure of the Guhua Clan?
This jade pendant was sold to me by an old friend when we parted, and that was when I decided in my heart that it should become just such a hereditary treasure.
Since I began wearing this jade pendant, I feel a dull headache every time I practice martial arts.
Uhh...
Sounds like this jade pendant has some issues...

Bah, nonsense! The first day I wore it, an adeptus came to me in a dream and taught me the secret arts of the Guhua Clan. The adeptus even said that it was fated that the pendant should have come into my possession.

The pains I feel in my head are merely growing pains, signs that my consciousness is expanding. That's what the novels say, after all! These are the signs that my thoughts and my will are growing stronger. There can be no problems here!
Unless... Ah, right, yes, I get it!
...Hehehehehe, hahahaha!
I see now! You want this jade pendant, but are too afraid to ask, yes? Thus, you seek to use this so-called "problem" as an excuse. How very "moral" of you... I mean, how very polite of you!
But nay, this is the Guhua Clan's great treasure. If you wish to claim it from me, you must...

...You must surely exchange it for something of equal value! Yes! Like a gem the size of a pigeon egg, or something! What would I do about my wounded pride as the 320th-generation disciple of the Guhua Clan otherwise?
Looks like it's this weird pendant thing that's made this guy believe that he's a Guhua disciple, {NICKNAME}... and it's driving him kinda nuts, too.
If he keeps wearing that pendant... and keeps staying this far above ground, something terrible's gonna happen to him for sure.
So he wants us to get him some "gem the size of a pigeon egg," eh? But he doesn't look like he can tell left from right or good from bad right now...
So let's try giving him a few Bird Eggs, shall we?
Well? Like I said, if you can offer an item of equal value, I can give this to you, no problem.

dialogue.sit: (Well, let's try giving him a Bird Egg...)

dialogue.t: There you go, we'll trade this for that jade pendant.
This is a... gemstone, the size of a bird's egg, you know!
The size of a bird's egg? Why, I never... I thought that a gem the size of a pigeon's egg was as large as they could get, but a bird's egg...?
Hehehe, a jade pendant for such a large gem. What a deal!
And this, naturally, is thanks to the magnanimous inclination of us Guhua disciples— I mean, it was on account of your great sincerity! Yes! Your great sincerity, that led us to make this trade.

dialogue.sit: Tang Wuchou takes the pendant off and passes it to you...

dialogue.t: As for this jade pendant, you take it. Your destiny is intertwined with that of us of the Guhua Clan, it seems, so do take care of this treasure.
Hahaha, where'd that expression of discontent on your face go, eh?
Huh, this thing is filled with Geo energy... Isn't this Smaragdus Jadeite?
Paimon remembers Baizhu saying something about it... Not that Paimon remembers it in full, but whatever it was, this stuff isn't all that good for people.
That's not possible. My sworn brother bought this for me... How could he seek to harm me?
And he has made so many other ornaments from jade to boot...
Your friend, you say?
That's right. We call him Old Chou. He works in the jade industry.

dialogue.sit: Where is he right now?
Is he still selling those ornaments?

dialogue.t: He should be near The Chasm. Last I heard, he's still helping to sell ornaments made from jade...
{NICKNAME}, if that person's still selling ornaments made from Smaragdus Jadeite, there could be a lot of people being put in harm's way.
We'd better go down there and check!
As for this jade pendant, you take it. Your destiny is intertwined with that of us of the Guhua Clan, it seems, so do take care of this treasure.
Hahaha, where'd that expression of discontent on your face go, eh?
Huh, this thing is filled with Geo energy...
Most normal people don't come into contact with elemental energy in their daily lives. There's bound to be trouble if they stay beside such a huge concentration of energy all the time.
That's not possible. My sworn brother bought this for me... How could he seek to harm me?
And he has made so many other ornaments from jade to boot...
Your friend, you say?
That's right. We call him Old Chou. He works in the jade industry.

dialogue.sit: Where is he right now?
Is he still selling those ornaments?

dialogue.t: He should be near The Chasm. Last I heard, he's also helping to sell ornaments made from jade...
{NICKNAME}, if that person's still selling jade ornaments of this sort, there could be a lot of people being put in harm's way.
We'd better go down there and check!
Ah, who'd have thought, who'd have thought? That the world might play host to a gem the size of a bird's egg?
Ah, hello there, you two. Is there anything I can help you with?
Are you here to try your hand at digging for treasure, just for a bit of fun?
Nope. We've got something else to talk to you about today.

dialogue.sit: This jade pendant...
You sold this, yes?

dialogue.t: Ah, this jade pendant...
Yes, I did indeed sell it here. Let me have a more careful look at it... Wait a moment. This texture, this smoothness, this translucence... Isn't this the very one I sold to Tang Wuchou?
Aye, indeed, I knew from the start that this one was different from the others.
At the time, I had wanted to sell it for a pretty sum, but it caught Tang Wuchou's eye, and so he begged and cajoled me... until I sold it to him on the cheap.
So there's only one that looks like this?
I sure wish I could pull a second one out of my hat, that's for sure.

Phew! Good thing it was just this one! This material is filled with elemental energy. If someone without a Vision is in contact with it, they will experience changes in personality and start talking nonsense day in and day out...
Tang Wuchou currently believes himself to be a great hero of the Guhua Clan, and spends his days behaving all crazy and stuff.
What? H—How could this be?
...Actually, now that you mention it, this gem does resemble the fabled "Smaragdus Jadeite" quite a bit. That material was said to cause its wearers some discomfort.
I heard the older folks say while Smaragdus Jadeite is very valuable, it is a thing of ominous portents, and that long-term exposure will bring about calamity.
...Oh no. I've doomed Tang, haven't I?
*sigh* We were both Treasure Hoarders once. We decided to part ways after making a pretty sum at The Chasm.

I do not know where Tang Wuchou went off to, but as for me... I was found by our former companions. They threatened me, and forced me to buy the low-quality jewelry they make here and sell it in Liyue.
They call it "helping with sales," but really... are the materials they use the equal of Shenglu Hall? Or their designs a match for Mingxing Jewelry?
They're just making me do the dirty work for them.
I had to lower the price so much that I was practically losing Mora on sales.

I basically used up all the Mora I made in our previous job... But it seems like those fellows have finally woken up to the idea that they might sell the base materials for a better price. They haven't come to look for me at all recently.

dialogue.sit: Actually, they've all been captured by Millelith who infiltrated their ranks.
You tell Old Chou about the destruction of the smuggling den...

dialogue.t: Hah! That was a good catch for sure, that was!
They even threatened to report me to the Millelith too, you know! Now look who's going to eat prison food, hmm?
... *sigh* Sorry, I got off topic. I'm very sorry about Tang, but I... I've buried all my valuables in the dirt... You know, to do a little business, earn a little Mora?
How about this, then? I'll let you dig for treasure once. You can give whatever you find to Tang Wuchou as compensation.
Well, how about it? Wanna know how you can dig for treasure here?

dialogue.sit: Don't worry, I've got it...
Sure, explain the rules to me...

dialogue.t: Well then, let's begin the round now!
Ah, hello there, you two. Is there anything I can help you with?
Are you here to try your hand at digging for treasure, just for a bit of fun?
Nope. We've got something else to talk to you about today.

You sold this, yes?

Sure, explain the rules to me...

dialogue.t: Well then, let's begin the round now!
Well, how about a round of treasure-hunting, right now? Whatever you dig up will go to Tang Wuchou as compensation.
Well, let's have a look. What did you get?
Oh, so you actually got this bag, huh...
What's inside...?
Oh. Uh, these ornaments are kinda...

dialogue.sit: ...Ghastly.

dialogue.t: Well, they were made by the Treasure Hoarders, and proved just about as popular as their makers.
But if nothing else, they're still made of genuine materials, so you can still cut those gems out and sell them for a pretty sum... *sigh*
Just give this to Tang, will you?
Alright, we're off, then!
Aye. If you have the time, come around and dig for some more treasure, alright?
Should we go back now, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: Yeah, let's go back and look for Tang Wuchou...
Let's pass it to him later...

dialogue.t: Hey-ho! This gem is as large as a bird's egg, yes, but it is so very light!
And when you hold it up against the light, you can see a shadow within! Fascinating, how very fascinating...
He's still looking at that egg, huh...
Hey, Mr. Guhua Hero!
Sorry, what? Ah, yes! That's me, Tang Wuchou, 320th-generation successor to the Guhua Clan! Surely you must have come hence upon hearing of my great deeds...
Eh? Oh, it's you two. Right, how about it, then? Did you find Old Chou?

dialogue.sit: We did find him, yes...
Let's start from the top, shall we...
You tell Tang Wuchou about Smaragdus Jadeite and give him Old Chou's compensatory gift.

dialogue.t: That's one huge bag... Lemme see what's in it, eh?
What in the world is with all these ornaments? ...And they're all so...
...Ugly.
What, is Old Chou trying to make a fool of me? Huh?
That jade pendant made from Smaragdus Jadeite cost me lots of Mora! And he even kept contact with those sneaky Treasure Hoarders after supposedly washing his hands off the business!
...Ah, this ancient grudge... I might just have to cut him down for it.
And you call yourself a hero...
Wasn't that jade pendant something you wanted to buy yourself, anyway?
...Hehehehehe, hahahaha!
You have a point.
And it's not like he's got anything to do with the Treasure Hoarders anymore. He's opened a store to let people try their hand at digging for treasure.
Digging for treasure? ...Pfft, so he's doing that again... He used to pull that trick to get Mora for wine.
Let me tell you something... That treasure hunt of his works like this: the <color=#00E1FFFF>better the goods, the more explosive barrels there will be around it, and vice versa.</color>
For example, tiles that turn out to be empty won't have a single explosive barrel near it, while the best stuff is probably surrounded on all four sides by such barrels.
Stingy fellow. He's deathly afraid that someone will get their hands on the good stuff, so he set the rules up such that the game ends once you dig up one explosive barrel.
Huh, but he said that he'd just let us keep going this time even if we dug them up...
Is... is that so? Well... I suppose there's some goodness left in his heart yet.
*sigh* Fair enough. And if I had been there with him back then, my martial prowess would have prevented him from being manipulated by those Treasure Hoarders the way he was...

dialogue.sit: Your what now?
Your martial prowess?

dialogue.t: *cough* I mean, come on, I am a martial artist. There might still be some distance between me and a true hero, but I can still handle a few Treasure Hoarders, no problem!
I'll go look for him later with two jugs of wine next time, I suppose, and we'll have a chat then.

quests.description: A Treasure Hoarder at the top of The Chasm claims to be from the Guhua Clan. Is he crazy, or is he just lost? Or is there some other secret that lies behind this situation?
